description:
Steam sale history for one skin. Steam Community Market's own sale history for the skin, scraped from Steam's listing page: `points` of
`{recorded_at, price, volume}` where `price` is Steam's median sale price for that interval in cents and
`volume` the number of sales. Steam reports roughly hourly points for the recent month and daily beyond; ranges
of a year or more are condensed to one point per day (median price, summed volume). Empty when Steam has no
sale series for the item (unmarketable skins). History goes back to the skin's first sale, as far as 2015.
Refreshed continuously; the full series is cached for an hour.
name: get_skin_price_history
title: Steam sale history for one skin
